_doc: Timeline for build.mjs. dur in seconds (rounded to 1/30). in: cut | fade (0.4 s crossfade, overlaps the previous segment). bp = blueprint seconds. Missing files become placeholder slates; missing cues with text become macOS 'say' placeholders (FINAL=1 refuses both). liveDb = keep the clip's own sound at that gain. Cue 'at' is seconds from the segment start; note: true shows cards/note-synced.png while it plays.

cues.text: Phones run a web app. A small Bun relay links them to the TV app, built with React Native for Vega.
Our open-source library, doodle-cutout, turns a phone photo into a clean sticker.
Claude reads the drawing and decides how it plays: a name, stats, an ability, and where the eyes go.
On the Vega Virtual Device it starts in under half a second, and the race loop needs about a millisecond per frame.
Races sometimes froze at the start. The crash dump's thread stacks showed a watchdog deadlock. One task per frame, ink loaded during the countdown: fifty-two starts, zero freezes.
It's for families with kids from four to ten. Screen time that starts with crayons, and the youngest can really win. About one and a half cents per creature. First names only, no accounts.
